incident_report.incident: Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between CIRRUS SPEED and MASTER LUCKY which shifted in.  Between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres was held up behind ALSONSO.  After being shifted to the inside of ALSONSO then had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 300 Metres and the 150 Metres when being shifted to the inside of COMET RADIANCE and LAHORE to improve.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race.  Before being allowed to race again, LAHORE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start made contact with POET’S REIGN.
When placed under pressure in the Home Straight lay in and proved difficult to ride out.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Near the 400 Metres lay in and as a result blundered and became unbalanced.

Over the final 400 Metres was held up and could not be ridden out to the finish.  Over the concluding stages was bumped on the hindquarters by BEST FARM which shifted out after improving into a narrow run between CONSPIRATOR and BUSTLING CITY.

Z Purton reported that his mount, which was having its first race start, raced greenly during the race and finished off only fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Over the final 500 Metres was held up for clear running and as a result was unable to be tested.
Approaching the 150 Metres improved into a narrow run between CONSPIRATOR and BUSTLING CITY and near the 50 Metres made contact with CONSPIRATOR when taken out by BUSTLING CITY.
Slow to begin.  Over the final 50 Metres was held up behind LEADING DRAGON and as a result could not be ridden out to the finish.

Shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by FORTUNE GOLDSADDLE.  H Bowman could offer no excuse for his mount’s disappointing performance.  Trainer M Newnham stated that he had been satisfied with the horse leading into the race and could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing run.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
On jumping became unbalanced when bumped by COMET RADIANCE which shifted out.
After travelling a short distance made contact with I P O BROS due to both runners shifting ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Lay out rounding Home Turn.
Jumped only fairly.  Leaving the 900 Metres lay in and became unbalanced when it made contact with the running rail.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly.  Briefly held up for clear running approaching the 400 Metres.  For some distance approaching the 300 Metres raced tight between REWARDING TWINKLE and I P O BROS when improving into a narrow run between those two horses.

Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by CIRCUIT VICTORY which shifted out on jumping.  Near the 300 Metres shifted out and away from VIVA CHALEUR when that runner shifted out whilst giving ground.  As a consequence COME FAST FAY FAY made contact with SUPER ELITE near the 250 Metres.  Over the final 100 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving into a narrow run to the inside of REWARDING TWINKLE.
Shifted out on jumping and was bumped.

After travelling a short distance made contact with SHOTGUN due to both runners shifting ground.  Approaching the 500 Metres was hampered when taken wider by REWARDING TWINKLE which shifted out to improve.  H Bowman stated that his mount was obliged to race wide and without cover and hung out throughout the event before finishing the race off only fairly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

C L Chau reported that from the outside barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages to offset the outside draw.  Trainer D Eustace confirmed the instructions issued.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.
Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with VIVA CHALEUR.  Bumped near the 250 Metres and as a result was awkwardly placed close to REWARDING TWINKLE.
Near the 900 Metres commenced to race keenly when being crossed by GENERAL SMART and as a result shifted out and made contact with WOODFIRE CHAMP.
Bumped at the start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped near the 900 Metres.  L Hewitson reported that his mount failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped over the concluding stages.  Noted to have sustained a laceration to the left hind leg.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Over the concluding stages shifted out and made contact with PATCH OF THETA.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Leaving the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid DROMBEG BANNER (A Atzeni) which shifted in when not quite clear.  A Atzeni was advised to exercise more care.
Shortly after the start raced tight between DROMBEG BANNER and TOMODACHI KOKOROE which shifted in slightly.
Shifted in at the start and was bumped.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped near the 1000 Metres.  Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 900 Metres shifted in and bumped WARRIORS DREAM. C L Chau was severely reprimanded in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on three occasions in the Home Straight. Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped near the 1100 Metres.  Near the 700 Metres became unbalanced when it shifted out and away from MERLION and made contact with DASHING PEACH.
Crowded on jumping between RUN RUN SMART and AUTUMN VIBES which shifted in.  Over the concluding stages could not be fully ridden out when awkwardly placed close to CHILL PARTNERS.

After the 1000 Metres raced tight to the inside of BROWNNEEDSFURTHER (J Orman) which shifted in.  J Orman was advised to exercise more care.  Held up for clear running between the 450 Metres and 350 Metres.  Near the 200 Metres was shifted to the outside of BROWNNEEDSFURTHER to continue into clear running.    Noted to have blood in the mouth after the race.

Bumped on jumping.  Near the 1000 Metres shifted out when being corrected by its rider and as a result made contact with CHILL PARTNERS.  Near the 900 Metres was bumped by CHILL PARTNERS when that runner shifted in when racing keenly.

Shifted out on jumping.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres was held up for clear running behind MERLION.  Leaving the 100 Metres was then shifted to the outside of VIVA FIRECRACKER to continue into clear running.  Over the concluding stages could not be fully ridden out when positioned close to VIVA FIRECRACKER which shifted out when awkwardly placed close to CHILL PARTNERS.
Bumped on jumping.  Briefly crowded near the 50 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Passing the 900 Metres made contact with the running rail and became unbalanced.  Briefly crowded approaching the 50 Metres.  Apprentice E C W Wong reported that his mount jumped only fairly and then was further hampered when crowded by VIVA FIRECRACKER.  He said as a consequence RUN RUN SMART settled further back in the field than intended.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with VIVA FIRECRACKER.  Despite being ridden along in the early stages did not show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Approaching the 1100 Metres shifted in and away from WARRIORS DREAM and made contact with LUCKY XANDER.  Raced wide and without cover from the 700 Metres.  Near the 700 Metres was bumped by BROWNNEEDSFURTHER.  Near the 350 Metres was hampered when taken wider by BROWNNEEDSFURTHER which shifted out.

Near the 100 Metres RUN RUN SMART improved to the outside of WARRIORS DREAM, resulting in MERLION being placed in restricted room.  Near the 50 Metres MERLION was then checked when crowded between MABUBU which shifted in and away from VIVA FIRECRACKER which also shifted in and RUN RUN SMART (Apprentice E C W Wong) which shifted out and away from WARRIORS DREAM after being taken out slightly by that runner.  After considering all the evidence Apprentice Wong was advised in similar circumstances he would be expected to make a greater effort to straighten his mounts to avoid causing interference to other runners.
Held up for clear running approaching the 400 Metres.

After travelling a short distance raced tight to the inside of DASHING PEACH.  Approaching the 1100 Metres was bumped by WARRIORS DREAM and as a result shifted in and made contact with BROWNNEEDSFURTHER.  Near the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid DASHING PEACH (B Avdulla) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  B Avdulla was advised to exercise more care.
Sent for sampling post-race.
On jumping was hampered when crowded between SMART GOLF and HONORARY which shifted out.  Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shortly after the start was bumped and became unbalanced.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
Shortly after the start raced tight to the inside of KA YING WARRIOR.
Jumped only fairly.  Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between ADORABLE SMILE and KIAMA.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 1000 Metres was steadied to avoid CLOUD NINE (L Ferraris) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear before being corrected by its rider.  L Ferraris was severely reprimanded.  M F Poon reported that with sheepskin cheek pieces being reapplied his mount raced keenly before finishing the race off only fairly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shifted out on jumping and was bumped.  M Chadwick reported that his instructions were to go forward.  He said when HONORARY jumped better today he was able to comply with the instructions that had been issued.
Approaching the winning post was steadied to avoid KIAMA (D B McMonagle) which shifted in.  D B McMonagle was advised to exercise more care.
From a wide barrier raced ungenerously when being shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
R Kingscote reported that his mount lay out in the Home Straight and proved difficult to ride out.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped shortly after the start.  Near the 150 Metres was bumped slightly by GLOWING PRAISES which shifted in and away from WONDERSTAR.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped shortly after the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Over the final 200 Metres hung in when placed under pressure. C Y Ho was warned in relation to using his whip forward of the saddle in a forehand manner on two occasions before the 100 Metres.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.
Over the concluding stages raced tight to the inside of ALPHA STRIKE when that runner hung in.
Between the 350 Metres and the 200 Metres was held up for clear running when improving into a narrow run between BLUE ILLUSION and AKERMANIS GOLD.
Near the 200 Metres was steadied to avoid SIGHT HERMOSO (B Avdulla) which shifted out when not clear.  B Avdulla was severely reprimanded.

Jumped awkwardly and made contact with the left side of the starting gate, resulting in its rider L Hewitson becoming badly unbalanced and his right foot being dislodged from his stirrup for some distance.
No report.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.
Jumped awkwardly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Sent for sampling post-race.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Lay in under pressure in the Home Straight.

Between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres was held up for clear running.  M Guyon reported that he was instructed to settle where comfortable.  He said after his mount jumped well and under its light weight of 119 lbs he was able to hold an on-pace position.
No report.
Crowded on jumping between SMART FAT CAT and ROBOT STAR, both of which shifted ground.  Was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres had some difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of ROBOT STAR.

Between the 400 Metres and the 250 Metres was held up for clear running.  L Ferraris stated that he was asked to ride the horse in a more conservative manner in the early stages with blinkers being removed as GLORIASTAR finished its recent races off only fairly when being asked to go forward.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when racing in restricted room between GLORIASTAR and AMAZING AWARD.  J McDonald stated that his mount jumped well today and settled in a more slightly forward position than its previous race starts.  He said in the Home Straight SMART FAT CAT finished the race off only fairly.
Shifted in at the start and was bumped.

Jumped awkwardly.  In the early stages raced ungenerously and got its head up.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have blood in its mouth and also to be a "roarer”.
Blundered badly on jumping, became unbalanced and lost ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
On jumping was crowded by FORTUNE KINGO which shifted in.  Between the 300 Metres and 200 Metres H Bentley had difficulty fully riding the horse out when his whip became entangled in his reins.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Held up for clear running between the 400 Metres and the 200 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Briefly held up for clear running near the 300 Metres. A Badel was fined the sum of $10,000 for using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on four occasions inside the 100 Metres. Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped shortly after the start.  J McDonald pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 150 Metres (see PUBLIC ATTENTION).
Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.  Making the turn approaching the 800 Metres lay in, resulting in its rider Z Purton having to correct his mount.  Lay in in the Home Straight.

Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Crowded near the 150 Metres.  Prior to declaring weighed-in Jockey M Guyon and Trainer W Y So viewed the patrol films to ascertain if there were grounds for a protest/objection against BEAUTY BOLT due to interference near the 150 Metres.  When they declined to lodge a protest/objection and the Stewards were satisfied that there were not sufficient grounds to do so having regard to the margin of three quarters of a length between the two horses at the finish of the race weighed-in was declared on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.

After travelling a short distance was eased when racing tight to the inside of BEAUTY BOLT which shifted in slightly.  On a number of occasions near the 400 Metres was bumped by PATCH OF COSMO and as a result became unbalanced.  Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of H Bowman, 6th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse’s finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ensure that he fully rides his mounts out to the finish of the race. Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Jumped only fairly.  Passing the 50 Metres L Ferraris dropped his left rein for a number of strides.

Jumped only fairly.  Between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres was held up for clear running when unable to improve into a tight run between WINDLORD and INVINCIBLE IBIS.  In this incident PATCH OF COSMO made contact with INVINCIBLE IBIS on a number of occasions.  Near the 200 Metres was steadied when crowded between INVINCIBLE IBIS and CRIMSON FLASH which was taken out by LITTLE PARADISE (C Y Ho) which shifted out.  C Y Ho was reprimanded.

J McDonald (BEAUTY BOLT) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 150 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of TOP DRAGON, resulting in TOP DRAGON being crowded onto PUBLIC ATTENTION, resulting in PUBLIC ATTENTION losing its rightful running and being checked.  J McDonald was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Sunday, 8 February 2026 at Sha Tin.  In addition, Jockey McDonald was fined $60,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his excellent race riding record.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped on jumping.

Jumped only fairly and shortly after shifted in and bumped SAGACIOUS LIFE.  Near the 200 Metres was eased to avoid INVINCIBLE IBIS which shifted in.  Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Shifted in on jumping and bumped CRIMSON FLASH.  L Hewitson stated that his mount hung in throughout the event and near the 200 Metres struck the running rail and became unbalanced.  He said as a result he did not test the horse thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Approaching the 1400 Metres got its head up and became unbalanced when being steadied.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out on jumping and was bumped.  Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Near the 400 Metres shifted to the outside of STAR SATYR to obtain clear running and made contact with HAPPY BOSS.
Jumped awkwardly.
Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by NYX GLUCK which shifted out.  Bumped near the 400 Metres.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  B Avdulla reported that near the 550 Metres his mount shifted in abruptly and became unbalanced and as a result he was obliged to correct the horse at that point.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Raced keenly in the middle stages and near the 850 Metres was steadied to avoid HAPPY ALLIANCE.
No report.

On jumping was hampered when bumped by HAPPY BOSS.  Z Purton stated that his mount did not fully stretch out during the running of the race and he had some concern with its action when he placed it under pressure in the Home Straight.  Trainer A S Cruz advised that the horse had pleased him leading into the race but, in his opinion, would be better suited with a race being run with a more genuine pace.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of STAR SATYR was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race starts.  Before being allowed to race again, STAR SATYR will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped awkwardly and became unbalanced and shortly after was steadied to avoid STAR SATYR which shifted out after being bumped by HAPPY BOSS.  Between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.

Bumped shortly after the start.  K Teetan stated that his mount came under pressure in the early stages of the Home Straight before giving ground noticeably over the concluding stages.  Trainer B Crawford stated that the horse had pleased him leading into the race but as LUNAR DASH was racing first up from a two-month break he was of the opinion it would derive a fitness benefit from today’s performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of LUNAR DASH was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race starts.  Before being allowed to race again, LUNAR DASH will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  M L Yeung reported that from a wide barrier he was instructed to take up a forward position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of CIRCUIT HAPPY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, CIRCUIT HAPPY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly and then made contact with CHIU CHOW SPIRIT.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Briefly held up on the Home Turn.  Near the 350 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving into a narrow run between SERAPH GABRIEL and CALIFORNIA WAVES.  In this incident NATURAL NUMBERS made contact with CALIFORNIA WAVES as it improved into the run.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Over the concluding stages could not be fully ridden out when awkwardly placed to the inside of NATURAL NUMBERS which shifted in slightly.

Near the 300 Metres was directed to the inside of BEAUTY CRESCENT and ENDUED to continue into clear running.  Near the 200 Metres blundered when being shifted to the inside of LIGHTNESS OF BEING.  After the 200 Metres THE RED HARE was eased and shifted to the outside of ARIEL to continue into clear running.  M Guyon advised that from a wide barrier he was instructed to find cover but his mount was obliged to settle back in the field when unable to comply with those instructions in the early stages.
No report.
No report.
Near the 350 Metres was bumped and taken wider by NATURAL NUMBERS.
No report.

Near the 1200 Metres was bumped by BEAUTY CRESCENT when that horse was racing keenly.  C Y Ho reported that, in his opinion, the horse races better at Happy Valley.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped at the start.  H Bowman stated that his mount was disadvantaged by being obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event and as a result finished the race off only fairly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Z Purton stated that after jumping awkwardly and losing ground his mount settled further back in the field than intended.   He said BEAUTY CRESCENT raced fiercely throughout the early and middle stages and refused to settle and as a consequence did not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Lay in over the final 200 Metres. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly.  Between the 400 Metres and 100 Metres was held up for clear running.  When improving into a narrow run between THRIVING BROTHERS and RIDING TOGETHER between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres made contact with those two runners on a number of occasions.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.  Held up for clear running approaching the 400 Metres when it shifted to the outside of FLUORESCENCE to obtain clear running.
Bumped on jumping.  Near the 900 Metres was momentarily crowded by SO YOU WILL which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.
No report.
Between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres was bumped on a number of occasions.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when racing tight to the inside of SIX PACK.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres was bumped on a number of occasions.
Slow to begin.

When questioned M Chadwick stated that the instructions were to settle the horse where comfortable.  He said from the outside barrier when caught wide in the early stages his mount settled towards the rear of the field when it was unable to hold a more forward position.  He said making the Home Turn he commenced to improve to the outside of MID WINTER WIND but as he attempted to improve between MID WINTER WIND and SO YOU WILL he was obliged to check his mount near the 300 Metres when MID WINTER WIND shifted out.  He said as a consequence he elected to shift back to the inside where it obtained clear running passing the 300 Metres.  Trainer W K Mo confirmed the instructions were to find cover.
Bumped on jumping.
Raced very wide and without cover from the 800 Metres.
Jumped only fairly.
On jumping got its head up after making contact with the left side of its starting gate.
